versioning_policy.rule: Contract versions are semantic by wire/on-disk compatibility, not by implementation release. Additive optional fields may stay on the same /vN only when existing consumers keep passing. Required fields, enum tightening, path layout changes, or verdict/diagnostic semantic changes require a new /vN or an explicitly documented fix-forward migration window. This rule applies only to the two inter-product contracts below; Nopal's own product surface lives under docs/surface/ instead.
versioning_policy.diagnostics: Stable diagnostic codes are part of the contract. Consumers match on code and severity, never prose.
versioning_policy.conformance: Every contract entry points at a conformance home. A contract is not distribution-ready until its owner ships fixtures and at least one implementation runner there.
